Nonogram

Nonogram — solve three hand-designed picture logic puzzles (5×5, 10×10, 15×15) with row and column clues.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a puzzle: 5×5, 10×10 or 15×15.
  2. Click cells to fill, right-click (or ✕ mode) to cross out.
  3. Use row/column clues to find the hidden picture.
  4. Fill every picture cell — with no extras — to win.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I play?

Click a cell to fill it, right-click (or switch to ✕ mode) to mark it empty. Fill all and only the picture cells to win.

What do the clue numbers mean?

The numbers are runs of consecutive filled cells. “3 1” means a run of 3 filled cells, then at least one gap, then 1 filled cell.

Can I get help while solving?

Turn on “Flag mistakes” and wrong fills are marked red the moment you place them — great for learning.
